summary: The decision-making process involves vague wording that leaves the choice entirely to one party. Employees are required to serve a three-month probation period after joining. During this probation, either party can end employment with seven days' written notice. After confirmation, the employee must provide sixty days' notice before resigning, and the notice period after confirmation is thirty days. Furthermore, the Company has the right to deduct any loan or advance from the final salary.
